notes.title: Bugfix Patch 01.03.08
notes.content:
[u]Bug Fixes[/u]
[list]
[*] Added Clear All progress button in the Save File Menu. This allows you to delete data of all gathered Items across all save files.
[*] Updated inputs to have more consistent release detection for Hiei and Jamal. This allows ninja and boxer to have more reliable keypresses for each consecutive input of their 'ranged' attacks.
[*] Added character limit to player name. It can go beyond the character limit, but will be cut off for display purposes.
[/list]

[u]Quality of Life[/u]
Submitted a PS4 default configuration that supports a deadzone. This should make moving in the menu with a PS4 analog stick less stressful.

notes.title: World Record Speedrun Set
notes.content:
Any% Password - 15m 08s

Record holder- RikkaFresh

https://www.speedrun.com/yomi_domini#any_password

Currently RikkaFresh has split the categories into 2 divisions:

Any% password which includes the secret code to unlock all skills
&
Any% new save which requires runners to scavenge the skill they need to pick up to set their best time.

This also leaves open the 100% run category open to collect all skills.

What about you? Can you beat his time?

notes.title: Post Launch Patch 01.03.07 (Bug Fixes)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Doors regularized in Unlocked Frame Rate
[*] Input detection using Melee attacks to pick up items more responsive.
[*] "Focus Attack" boxer skill lunge range tripled.
[*] Fire light flickering speed reduced.
[/list]

notes.title: Post Launch Patch 01.03.00
notes.content:
